decisions.decision: Preserve the exact-hash r1 F109 ROM as an isolated diagnostic candidate; keep r2 as default and do not promote the overflow to a passing H40 budget.
decisions.reason: MDRT/VLAB do BlastEm confirmaram 22 sprites por scanline e 176/320 px no estado F109 congelado. A captura parece intacta, mas o teto H40 segue em 20; o hold faz as 1182/1200 amostras excedidas deixarem de representar a sequencia natural.

decisions.decision: Retain r1 as a visual-tolerance candidate while keeping r2 as default; record the H40 count overrun explicitly.
decisions.reason: O usuario observou F109 e disse que funcionou perfeitamente visualmente. A ROM natural mediu 22 celulas SGDK cruzando a mesma linha em 2/1200 quadros, 176/320 px. A sonda conta sprites visiveis por interseccao vertical e nao filtra X; as trajetorias r1 em F109 permanecem dentro da area horizontal, portanto o excesso nao vem de celulas fora da tela. Isso torna a direcao visual toleravel para comparacao, mas nao reduz o teto H40 de 20 nem prova que o VDP apresentou todas as 22 celulas.
decisions.measurement_caveat: Software Sprite list geometry; counts VDP cells whose Y spans the line; does not filter X or inspect final SAT/pixels after overflow.

decisions.decision: Keep the existing 64x8x8 r2 runtime default; retain 80x8x8 only as a measured visual-density candidate.
decisions.reason: The approved B model-sheet crop regenerates the exact same 64 anchors as r2 without reading /res. Across 990 measured inputs, 64x8x8 peaks at 13 sprites/104 pixels; 80x8x8 peaks at 16/128 but uses all 80 SAT links. The user finds r1 F109 visually perfect, while its 22-sprite demand remains above the H40 limit and is not evidence that all 22 reached the SAT.

decisions.decision: Keep the menu text single-draw correction as an isolated WIP fix; retain V012 only as a visual comparison candidate.
decisions.reason: The prior +1 tile shadow created an 8 px duplicate row. The separate handoff ROM shows a clean menu and visible menu/demo/replay state changes. A second V012 hold ROM shows bright readable SGDK/FORGE and the replay prompt; the earlier dim samples were unmarked wall-clock captures. PAL_initFade's count-based copy matches the supplied palette subarray, so no palette change is indicated.
decisions.note: The user feedback on the separate F109 r1 frame is visual tolerance only and does not approve V012 or the full Splash V3.

decisions.decision: Keep V018 as opt-in WIP; V006 remains the default and V017 remains a negative control.
decisions.reason: The exact-hash still shows a broken lower shelf instead of the dominant continuous line. Human visual review, full VDP budget, audio and delivery gates remain open.

decisions.decision: Keep V018 as WIP and r2 as the default candidate. Treat the rare r1 F109 22-sprite peak as visually tolerated for WIP comparison only; retain the H40 over-limit classification.
decisions.reason: The user reports the r1 F109 image looked perfect. This prevents the hard 20-sprite H40 ceiling from being misused as an automatic aesthetic rejection rule, while keeping hardware budget claims truthful. The corrected d46 r2 candidate measures 14 sprites/112 pixels and 64 allocated particles with zero failures. It still has 37/1200 CPU-over-budget frames and no physical DMA/VRAM readback.

decisions.decision: Keep V019 as an opt-in visual WIP candidate for review; retain V006 as the default backdrop and V017 as the unchanged project ROM baseline.
decisions.reason: The native 320x224 exact-hash hold shows the SGDK/FORGE lockup clearly against a dark center and the V019 translation removes the continuous lower horizon/floor read. The hold is only one visual state and remains needs_review.
decisions.preview_prompt: A: REVER is an interface label in SPLASH_V3_VISUAL_PREVIEW, not final brand art.

decisions.decision: Separate HUD countdown from transition readiness; keep input and nested transitions locked until destination entry, fade and DMA finish.
decisions.reason: ROM RAM at physical frame 464 showed countdown zero and asynchronous fade still active; unlock occurred at 466. B during lock reached gInput without changing scene; later B and START drove replay/menu/demo.

decisions.decision: Keep opt-in SPLASH_V3_MOTION_LUT after exact compiled-coordinate equivalence and material emulated cadence improvement.
decisions.reason: 6324 pairs equal C reference; 241 intervals improve from 345 to 282 VBlanks, with sweep 58 to 30. Retain full particle population and visuals.

decisions.decision: Reject linear scan probe optimization and restore the original source.
decisions.reason: Host differential passed 512 cases twice, but same 282-VBlank cadence and phase histogram: no material gain.

decisions.decision: Use v005 contract and compare all 154 active spark positions against the unchanged C reference before measuring separation.
decisions.reason: Two Y handles in offline v004 contract diverged from compiled source; corrected minimum is 22.09px, not 23.54px.

decisions.decision: Select the guarded fixed-geometry LUT variant as the technical WIP candidate; reject visibility cache and retain full probe.
decisions.reason: Eight compiled frame descriptors share one stationary 8x8 cell and zero timer; runtime guard true. Nine real SAT chains are byte-identical. Two cadence captures repeat 278 VBlanks/241 intervals versus 345 initially; convergence remains 66/36.

decisions.decision: Select G with packed submitted SAT observer; reject both direct tile variants and restore exact G source.
Select O: correct queued CRAM ownership and achieve one VBlank per visible update with all64 particles; reject no-gain initial-delay P.
